backend/main.mo: Motoko backend with access control, user profile storage, enquiry CRUD, and admin-only operations using email-based authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking UI/admin enhancements and React Query additions to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files describing their structure, purpose, and recent functional changes.
frontend/DEPLOYED_PUBLIC_URL.md: Documentation explaining deployed public URL, custom domain remapping steps, and verification checklist.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_OUTPUT.md: Record of the latest deployment including date, status, and placeholder for the new canister URL.
frontend/GOOGLE_INDEXING_GUIDE.md: Guide for setting up Google Search Console and sitemap submission using the deployed canister URL.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme configuration using OKLCH variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML template with metadata, favicons, Open Graph tags, and script entrypoint.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Minimal sitemap listing the root page with metadata.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing view switching, metadata updates, and rendering landing or enquiries sections.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component showing brand info, contact links, quick navigation, and scroll-to-section handling with home-view navigation logic.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with logo, desktop and mobile navigation, section scrolling, and navigation to the enquiries view.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Renders the About section with highlights describing the service’s guidance, team, track record, and support.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact form with validation and enquiry submission plus static contact info display.
frontend/src/components/sections/Coverag: Displays primary and secondary coverage regions and related benefits for the service.
frontend/src/components/sections/Enquiri: Admin-only enquiries dashboard with login, profile completion, enquiry fetching, and marking enquiries as answered.
frontend/src/components/sections/FaqSect: Renders a FAQ section using an accordion, displaying a list of questions and answers about counselling services.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Implements the landing hero section with headings, CTAs, stats, and a featured image, including smooth scroll actions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Process: Shows a 5-step counselling process using cards with icons, titles, and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Displays a grid of service cards outlining various counselling offerings with icons and descriptions.
frontend/src/components/sections/Testimo: Renders testimonial cards with quotes, ratings, and student details.
frontend/src/constants/admin.ts: Defines the authorized admin email and utility functions for normalizing and validating admin emails.
frontend/src/constants/contact.ts: Exports shared constants for contact phone and email information.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, handling initialization and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to check if the caller is an admin and to retrieve the caller's user role using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity login, storing and restoring identities and exposing login state helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, creating, and updating enquiries through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and save the authenticated caller's user profile using React Query.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/runtimePublicUrl.ts: Updates the app’s og:url meta tag at runtime based on the current origin.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, plugins, and dark mode.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking features, issues, and a pending authorization fix request.
